target: UTM-bundled QEMU framework, HVF, PCI ARM64 graphical guest, 1 vCPU, 1 GiB RAM, VirtIO keyboard/tablet
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-task-message-scheduling-current.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-source-fast --probe-source tests/compat/TaskMessages.ZC --probe-source-call TaskMessageSchedulingChecks
verified: Five consecutive MessageScan, KeyScan, CharScan and FlushMessages polls did not run the peer task.
An explicit Yield selected the next ready peer.
A blocked MessageGet yielded to a ready peer, received its posted command and resumed.
scope_note: This validates the cooperative host bridge on the current image, not the pinned upstream Sched.ZC as the active runtime scheduler. It does not verify multi-CPU scheduling or visible UTM-app behavior.
